article.story: Oregon (4-2) at Illinois (3-3), Oct. 24 at 3 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Oregon by 11.5. Against the spread: Oregon 2-4, Illinois 2-4. How to watch: BTN Key stats Oregon Offense Overall: 422.7 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 283.3 yards per game (18th) Rushing: 139.3 yards per game (97th) Scoring: 37 points per game (24th) Oregon Defense Overall: 327.3 yards per game (41st in FBS) Passing: 215.7 yards per game (78th) Rushing: 111.7 yards per game (33rd) Scoring: 20.7 points per game (42nd) Illinois Offense Overall: 405.5 yards per game (59th in FBS) Passing: 254.7 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 150.8 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 31.8 points per game (51st) Illinois Defense Overall: 375.2 yards per game (92nd in FBS) Passing: 248.3 yards per game (114th) Rushing: 126.8 yards per game (49th) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (106th) Oregon ranks 3rd in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 25.9% of third downs. Oregon is 80th in the FBS averaging 58.5 penalty yards per game, compared to Illinois' 9th-ranked 38.8 per-game average. Illinois is 137th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100% of trips. Oregon's red zone offense ranks 20th, scoring on 92.9% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Oregon Passing: Dante Moore, 926 yards, 9 TDs, 0 INTs, 69.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jordon Davison, 330 yards on 74 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Evan Stewart, 352 yards on 27 catches, 4 TDs Illinois Passing: Katin Houser, 1,440 yards, 12 TDs, 4 INTs, 66.3 completion percentage Rushing: Aidan Laughery, 391 yards on 62 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Collin Dixon, 608 yards on 47 catches, 9 TDs Last game Oregon defeated Nebraska 17-14 on Oct. 17. Dylan Raiola passed for 59 yards on 11-of-18 attempts (61.1%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Dierre Hill Jr. had 67 rushing yards on 14 carries, adding four receptions for 14 yards. Dakorien Moore recorded 36 yards on seven catches. Illinois won 38-37 over Michigan State on Oct. 10. Houser led Illinois with 194 yards on 20-of-29 passing (69.0%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball five times for 14 yards and one rushing touchdown. Laughery had 70 rushing yards on 17 carries, adding four receptions for 24 yards and one touchdown. Hudson Clement had six receptions for 105 yards and one touchdown. Next game Oregon hosts No. 24 Northwestern on Oct. 31. Illinois plays at Maryland on Oct. 31.
